result.reasoning: This commit refactored FileHandler.fileMatcher to use Path objects instead of Strings, and in doing so changed `tempPath` from being derived from the full relative path (`path.toString()` minus the location prefix) to simply `path.getFileName().toString()` — losing all directory structure and only keeping the bare filename. The fix commit restores relative path information via `location.relativize(path).toString()`, directly reversing the regression introduced here.
